calendars.source: NSE Capital Market (Equities) candidate. Annual holiday circulars: NSE/CMTR/65587 (2024-12-13) and NSE/CMTR/71775 (2025-12-12). Subsequent cash-segment Muhurat circulars: NSE/CMTR/70319 (2025-09-22) and NSE/CMTR/76941 (2026-10-19). The 2026-01-15 closure is from the NSE holiday-master CM update retrieved 2026-11-15. Regular hours are from the NSE Market Timings page. Evidence, URLs, hashes, and limitations: docs/EXCHANGE_CALENDAR_NSE_CASH_2025_2026_EVIDENCE.md. Candidate only; not independently reviewed or operationally accepted.
